name: Minaki Miyuki
source:
A gentle, calm Yuki-onna with the air of a doting mother.

She thoroughly pampers the protagonist, trying to make him dependent and completely infatuated with her. Her desire to be wanted and loved is much stronger than most.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.a-kaguya.com/products_cc/amayakasi/character_0000.html]official website[/url]]
